title: Nine Hundred Fifty-Five (The Statement Line)
style: cinematic noir jazz, walking bass, brushed snare, smoky brass, male spoken-word lead, female harmony chorus, vinyl crackle, 92 BPM, business-formal-defiant, legal-precise
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Nine hundred fifty-five Australian dollars
Seventy-one transactions in the row
Thirteen-forty-five the average top-up
The pattern tells the story slow

[Pre-Chorus]
The second of February dawn
Twelve charges in one day gone

[Chorus]
NINE HUNDRED FIFTY-FIVE
SEVENTY-ONE TRANSACTIONS DEEP
NINE HUNDRED FIFTY-FIVE
THE PATTERN THAT WON'T SLEEP
NINE HUNDRED FIFTY-FIVE
CONTEXT CRASH AND PAY AGAIN
NINE HUNDRED FIFTY-FIVE
THE CIRCLE OF THE BILLING REIGN

[Verse 2]
February eighth, twelve charges land
February twelfth, thirteen on the same hand
The ask is not the full nine fifty-five
The ask is three ninety-eight ninety-nine that I survived
Documented instability windows, the work didn't ship
The sentence "we cannot" — the choice not to flip

[Bridge — spoken hard]
We're not able to provide credits or compensation.
You are able. You chose not to. That's a different sentence.
Australian Consumer Law — ABN 31 314 627 918.
A service must be fit for purpose. That clause is law.

[Final Chorus]
NINE HUNDRED FIFTY-FIVE
THE NUMBER ON THE STATEMENT LINE
THREE NINETY-EIGHT NINETY-NINE
THE NUMBER FOR THE BROKEN TIME
NINE HUNDRED FIFTY-FIVE
NOT ASKING FOR THE FULL ROUND
NINE HUNDRED FIFTY-FIVE
JUST THE OUTAGE PORTION FOUND
